import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { Menu } from '@/generated/auth-hooks'
import { danawaMenuConfig } from '@/shared/config/danawaMenu'
import { permittedMenusServerAction, systemMenusServerAction } from '@/shared/services/graphql/auth/authServerActions'
import type { ServiceMenu, ServiceMenu as ServiceMenuViewModel } from '@/shared/types/serviceMenu'

// 재귀 매핑 함수 (일반 사용자용)
const mapMenuToServiceMenu = (menu: Menu): ServiceMenuViewModel => ({
    id: menu.id?.toString() ?? '',
    name: menu.name ?? '',
    url: `${menu.domain ?? ''}${menu.path ?? ''}`,
    subMenus: (menu.subMenus ?? [])
        .filter((sub): sub is Menu => sub !== null && sub.isVisible === true)
        .sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0))
        .map(mapMenuToServiceMenu)
})

// 재귀 매핑 함수 (시스템/어드민용)
const mapAdminMenuToServiceMenu = (menu: Menu): ServiceMenuViewModel => ({
